title: Secret envelope (fabric-secret-envelope/1, DEC-0047)
description: A secret sealed with HPKE (RFC 9180, base mode, DHKEM(P-256, HKDF-SHA256) / HKDF-SHA256 / AES-128-GCM) to the target machine's key-agreement key, signed by the sealing machine's signing key over the RFC 8785 bytes of {header, ct}. The header is the AEAD's additional data. A relay stores it by digest and never reads it; FAC-SEM-070 and the open checks of DEC-0047 item 7 apply.

alg.description: the sender's signature algorithm, signed with the header; ES256 is the only one admitted (FAC-SEM-070, unsupported-alg)

recipient.description: the target's key-agreement key id, ending #kem

sender.description: the sealing machine's signing key id, ending #sig

slot.description: the credential's name, never its value

placement.description: the estate revision that placed this secret on the target

enc.description: the HPKE encapsulated key, an uncompressed P-256 point, base64url

ct.description: HPKE ciphertext with its tag, base64url
